name: MAIN STREET
note: Room 2. The hub, and the most-visited screen in the game. Every LOOK and LISTEN line here is verbatim from docs/05-examine-layer.md -- nothing on this screen is written by the engine or by anyone implementing it.

LOOK_AT.say: CONSOLATION IMPROVEMENT COMPANY. Gilt lettering. It is the only sign in town that has been painted twice.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It is the quietest building on the street and it is always full.

LOOK_AT.say: The tallest thing in Consolation, and the only building that is as deep as it is tall.

LISTEN_TO.say: The bell is a half-step flat. It has been struck by hand for six years by a man who does not care.

LOOK_AT.say: Claims for sale, claims disputed, a lost dog, and a man offering to write letters home for those who cannot. He is doing better than anyone.

LISTEN_TO.say: Paper, in wind. A great deal of it.

LOOK_AT.say: A dog with the settled look of an animal that has outlasted several owners.

LISTEN_TO.say: Breathing. Contented. He is the only solvent resident of Consolation.

LOOK_AT.say: A trough. Three inches of water and a great deal of ambition.

LISTEN_TO.say: Something is living in it. I have decided not to pursue this.

LOOK_AT.say: Six inches above the mud. In Consolation, this is the difference between a gentleman and a prospector.

LISTEN_TO.say: Loose board, third from the end. Everyone in town steps over it without thinking. Nobody has ever fixed it.

LOOK_AT.say: Every building on this street is two storeys tall in front and one storey deep. Consolation is a stage set that people have moved into.

LISTEN_TO.say: Wind. There is a great deal of nothing behind these.

LOOK_AT.say: Gold country. Everyone here has looked at these hills for years and seen a number.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. They are extremely large and they are not doing anything.

LOOK_AT.say: The same mud. I have begun to recognise individual portions of it.
